rules.statement: Consenting to judgment on a warrant of attorney for a larger sum than is mentioned in the warrant does not render the judgment a nullity but only an irregularity that is capable of amendment.
rules.supporting_quote: It is only an irregularity that is capable of amendment. Where judgment was entered for a sum in excess of the amount given in the warrant and it appeared that that sum was justly due, the Supreme Court refused to entertain application for restitutio in integrum to amend the decree.
